newsitem.title: UK: Moody's says may cut Cassa di Risparmio ratings.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says may cut Cassa di Risparmio ratings.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it had placed on review for possible downgrade the A2 long-term and the Prime 1 short-term deposit ratings, and the C financial strength rating, of Cassa di Risparmio in Bologna (Caribol).

Moody's said in a statement this rating action followed Caribol's recent announcement that an offer was to be made to acquire 52 percent of Banca Popolare dell'Adriatico for approximately 600 billion lire.
Moody's said the potential acquisition values Banca Popolare dell'Adriatico at approximately 1,100 billion lire and would result in a substantial element of goodwill.
Moody's said its review will consider the potential acquisition in the context of Caribol's strategic objectives, the potential synergies and its impact on the financial structure of Caribol.
Cassa di Risparmio in Bologna, headquartered in Bologna, Italy, had assets of 22,452 billion lire at 31 December 1995.
